description: This is a PHP source file defining the HolidayAPI class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. The class provides REST API endpoints for managing holiday data, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting holiday records. It uses various traits, models, validators, and API components to facilitate holiday management in the HR system.

classes.name: HolidayAPI
classes.description: REST API class providing endpoints for holiday management, including CRUD operations and listing holidays with filters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single holiday record by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all holidays matching certain filters such as date range.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new holiday record based on provided parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing holiday record identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more holidays based on provided IDs.

methods.name: setHolidayParams
methods.description: Helper method to populate a Holiday entity with request data.

methods.name: getIdFromUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts holiday ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for holiday ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a holiday.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a holiday.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting holidays.
